provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: 1962 reads `Adesto, Domine, supplicationibus` where 1862 reads `AD6sto, D6mine, supplicati6nibus`; 1962 reads `cognoscimus,` where 1862 reads `cogn6scimus,`; 1962 reads `Chrysogoni Martyris` where 1862 reads `Clirys6goni Mdrtyris`; 1962 reads `intercessione` where 1862 reads `intercessi6ne`; 1962 reads `Dominum` where 1862 reads `D6minum`; 1962 reads `Iesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.` where 1862 reads `*`; 1862 sets no comma after the opening ut; 1862 conclusion is `Per Dominum nostrum.`; the 1962 writes it out in full; 1862 layer damage: `Clirys6goni` for Chrysogoni, and a stray asterisk after the conclusion; the 1862's second printing of this Collect at lines 79308-79319 agrees with the first. Corroboration: the 1862 in two places; 1922 Mame carries 24 November at PDF pp. 876-877, not transcribed.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Adesto, Domine, supplicationibus nostris: ut, qui ex iniquitate nostra reos
nos esse cognoscimus, beati Chrysogoni Martyris tui intercessione liberemur.
Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat
in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Historical source comm-s-chrysogoni-martyris/main/Collect/all/1; same-witness-conclusion-table.
